title: [FMLA 03] HeronFormula — Heron's Formula
summary: Triangle area from three side lengths.

body.text: Calculator scroll name: HeronFormula. Triangle area from three side lengths.
If you only have the three side lengths (no angle), Heron still gives the area. The picture is that filled-in triangle.

body.caption: Example: sides 3, 4, 5. Semi-perimeter s = 6, so the shaded area is 6 — the well-known right triangle.

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 0, then 3 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: Triangle inequality
body.text: Sides must satisfy a+b>c, b+c>a, and c+a>b (all > 0). Otherwise the area is not defined and the routine errors.
